God,Ⓒs.ⒹdevaH, suraH, amaraH, nirjaraH, vibuDaH, suparvan m., sumanas m. tridiveSaH, divOkas m., AditeyaH, divizad m., leKaH, aditi-naMdanaH, AdityaH, fBuH, asvapnaH, amartyaH, amftAMDat m. bahirmuKaH, kratuBuk m., gIrvARaH, dAnavAriH, vfMdArakaH, dEvataH-taM; ‘great g(od)’ parameSvaraH, paramAtman; m. ‘goddess’ devI, BagavatI, surAMganA, devapatnI; in comp. words ex. by Darma; ‘g(od)-father’ Darmapitf m., so DarmamAtf f. DarmaputraH-trI, DarmakanyA-sutA, &c.
Ⓝ[God]less,Ⓒa.ⒹnirISvara, nAstika, anISvaravAdin.
Ⓝ[God]lessness,Ⓒs.ⒹmiTyAdfzwi f., nAstikatA.
Ⓝ[God]-like,Ⓒa.ⒹdevatulyarUpa, devopama, divya.
Ⓝ[God]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹDArmika (kI f.), DarmanizWa-parAyaRa, puRyaSIla, puRyAtman, ISvara-Bakta-pUjaka.
Ⓝ[God]liness,Ⓒs.ⒹDarmasevA, puRyaSI-latA, IzvaraBakti f., SradDA, &c.
Ⓝ[God]ship,Ⓒs.ⒹdevatvaM, devaBAvaH.
ⓃGodsend,Ⓒs.ⒹISvaraprerita a. iva, ISvaraprasAdaH, sOBAgyaM, lakzmIdattaM.

Good,Ⓒa.ⒹBadra, sADu, praSasta, praSasya, SuBa, kalyARa (RI f.), sat, vara, SoBana, guRavat, nirdoza; oft. by su or sat in comp.
Ⓑ
 2 DarmaSIla, sADu-Arya-vftta, sadAcAra, saccarita, sukftin, puRya, puRyAtman, puRyaSIla, DArmika (kI f.).

Ⓑ

Ⓑ
 5 anyUna, adUzita, akzata, saMpUrRa.

 6 bahu, pracura, mahat, analpa, BUri, su or ati pr.; ‘a g(ood) fellow’ BadraH, sOmyaH; ‘my g(ood) sir’, Badra, sOmya; ‘g(ood) quality’ guRaH, sadguRaH; [] ‘g(ood) wishes’ ASis f., ASIrvAdaH-vacanaM; ‘g(ood) and bad’ SuBASuBa; ‘so g(ood) as’ anugraha-pUrvakaM, kfpayA; ‘for g(ood)’ atyaMtaM, asannivfttyE; ‘a g(ood) deal’ BfSaM, atIva, su or ati pr.; ‘g(ood) morning to you’ SuBaste praBAtakAlaH; ‘it will be g(ood) for you’ tava kalyARAya Bavet, kalyARamAva-het; ‘is g(ood) unto weariness’ AyAsaja-nakameva, SramamAtradAyakaM^1; ‘g(ood) for nothing’ nirupayoga, nirguRa, nizPala; ‘as g(ood) as’ samaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹupakAraH, upakfti f.
Ⓑ
 2 hitaM, BUti f., BadraM, SuBaM, kalyARaM, kuSalaM, Sreyas n., kzemaM; oft. by arTa; ‘for the g(ood) of the people’ prajArTaM, lokahitAya, prajABUtaye, &c.
Ⓑ
 3 upa-yogaH, lABaH, PalaM; oft. ex. by kiM, arTa, alaM, with inst.; ‘what is the g(ood) of seeing her’ kiM tayA dfzwyA (S. 2), korTastasyA darSanena; ‘what g(ood) do you get by weeping’ alaM paridevanena.
Ⓑ
 4 sukftaM, puRyaM, DarmaH, sucaritaM, sADuvfttaM, sadAcAraH; ‘to do g(ood)’ upakf 8 U; hitaM-kalyARaM-kf; kzemaM Avah 1 P; ‘g(ood) and evil (bad)’ SuBASuBaM, hitAhitaM.
Ⓔinterj.ⒹsADu, suzwu, samyak, bAQaM, kAmaM, Bavatu, taTA-stu, taTeti; yujyate, anumataM mama (V. 2). ‘G(ood)-breeding’ sADutA, sOjanyaM, vinayaH, saByatA, ‘possessed of g(ood)-breeding’ suSIla, suvinIta, sujana, aBijAta; ‘g(ood) conditioned’ susTa, susTita; ‘g(ood) fortune or luck’ See Fortune; ‘g(ood)-humour’ sadBAvaH, ullAsaH, cittaprasAdaH, ullAsavftti f., AnaMdaH, pramodaH; ‘g(ood)-nature’ sadBAvaH, susvaBAvaH, sOjanyaM, suSIlatA; suprakfti f.; ‘g(ood)-humoured or g(ood)-natured’ hfzwacitta, prasannacitta, sollasa, sAnaMda, susvaBAva, suSIla, suprakfti, sujana, sadBAvavat, sADuSIla, DarmA-tman, puRyAtman, suhfdaya; ‘g(ood)-looking’ darSanIya, surUpa, sudarSana, suBaga, priyadarSana, prekzaRIya, ramyAkAra, suvadana; ‘g(ood)-manners’ vinayaH, vinItatA, maryAdA, sunIti-rIti f.; saByatA, SizwAcAraH, suSIlatA, sOjanyaM, su-sat-caritraM, sadAcAraH, sADuvfttaM; ‘g(ood)-sense’ vivekaH, jYAnaM, prajYatA, prabudDatA, praboDaH, sO-janyaM, sadBAvaH, suSIlatA; ‘g(ood)-will’ hitecCA, hitakAmyA, prIti f., priyatA, anukUlatA, Bakti f., anurAgaH.
Ⓝ[Good]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹcAru, suMdara (rI f.), surUpa, sudfSya, prekzaRIya, lAvaRyavat, ramya, ramaRIya, manorama-hara, rucira.
